description: This file defines the ServiceConfig class, which models the <service-config> XML element for configuring service engines within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating a ServiceConfig instance from an XML element, accessing service engines by name, and retrieving all configured service engines.

classes.name: ServiceConfig
classes.description: A model class representing the <service-config> XML element, encapsulating a collection of ServiceEngine instances.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Constructs a ServiceConfig instance from an XML Element representing <service-config>, parsing nested <service-engine> elements.

methods.name: getServiceEngines
methods.description: Returns a collection of all ServiceEngine instances configured.

methods.name: getServiceEngine
methods.description: Retrieves a ServiceEngine by its name.
